text.p: German dialysis group Fresenius Medical Care said on Friday that it planned to restructure its international operations in order to further enhance the group's international market position.

The group, a subsidiary of German medical equipment maker Fresenius AG, was created when Fresenius merged its dialysis business with that of National Medical Care, acquired from U.S. group W.R. Grace.
The group's international business will be split into business regions of Europe, Middle East and Africa as well as Latin America and Asia-Pacific.
Gerd Krick, management board chairman at Fresenius AG and Fresenius Medical Care will be in charge of the Latin America and Asia Pacific regions.

Emanuele Gatti, until recently exceutive vice president for Fresenius Medical Care's sourthen Europe region, will join the management board at Fresenius Medical Care and be in charge of the Europe, Middle East and Africa region.
Mathias Klingler, a board member of Fresenius AG and Fresenius Medical Care, has resigned, the group said it a statement.
